CustomObject.description: Controls MEDDPICC enforcement mode. When Full_MEDDPICC_Enabled__c is TRUE, all 8 MEDDPICC components are required at defined stage gates (Phase 2). When FALSE (default), Light MEDDPICC is enforced — Identify Pain required at Stage 2, Decision Criteria required at Stage 3. Toggle activated by Revenue Ops based on sales adoption feedback.
CustomObject.label: MEDDPICC Config
